categories.label: Agriculture and Crop Risk
categories.definition: Risks to agriculture and crops due to environmental factors.
categories.includes: Crop failures, pests, fertilizer shortages, harvest shocks.
categories.excludes: General agricultural news, market trends, non-crisis farming practices.

categories.label: Flood and Landslide Disaster

out_of_scope_policy: Reject signals that do not pertain to crisis or risk narratives, such as routine news, cultural events, sports, general business updates, and non-crisis human interest stories.
changes_vs_current: Merged similar categories to reduce overlap, such as combining mining-related risks into broader resource categories. Added explicit exclusions to each category to prevent force-fitting non-crisis signals. Introduced a clear out-of-scope policy to reject irrelevant signals, addressing the issue of force-fitting unrelated content into crisis categories.
